# Purpose
The provided file is a GitHub Actions workflow configuration written in YAML, designed to automate fuzz testing for a project named 'gson' using CIFuzz, a component of Google's OSS-Fuzz. This workflow is triggered on pull requests, ensuring that any new code changes are automatically tested for vulnerabilities. It consists of a job named "Fuzzing" that runs on the latest Ubuntu environment. The job includes steps to build the fuzzers using the CIFuzz action, execute them for a specified duration (600 seconds), and conditionally upload any crash artifacts if the build step succeeds but the fuzzing step encounters failures. This setup helps maintain code quality and security by identifying potential issues early in the development process.
